DefaultInstructions: In Default apps, search for Amoxtli or .md and choose the extensions to associate. Installing the MSIX package is required.
AboutText:
Markdown reader for Windows
Version 1.0

Native interface and reading with WinUI 3.
Markdown parsing with Markdig (BSD-2-Clause license).

Select text and copy with Ctrl+C.
FileTooLarge: This file exceeds the 8 MB reading limit.
EmptyFolder: This folder has no Markdown files or visible subfolders.
UnresolvedLink: Could not resolve the link. Pasted Markdown has no base folder.
NetworkFile: Open network files using the file picker.
MarkdownOnly: This reader only opens links to Markdown files.
Reloaded: The file changed and the view was updated.

WelcomeIntro: A quiet place to read your **Markdown** files with native Windows controls.
WelcomeOpen: Open a file with **Ctrl+O**, a folder with **Ctrl+Shift+O**, or drag them into this window.
WelcomeNavigation: Use **Ctrl+Shift+L** to show or hide the navigation pane. The contents tab lets you jump between headings.
WelcomeLinks: Web links open in your default browser. Right-click a link to copy its address or choose **Open with…**. Links to other Markdown files open here.
WelcomeFormats: Read **bold**, *italic*, ~~strikethrough~~, ++underlined++ and ==highlighted== text, tables, lists, tasks, quotes and footnotes.
WelcomeSettings: Choose your language, theme, text size and remote image preference in **Reading preferences**. Language changes take effect immediately.
WelcomeLimitations: Raw HTML, LaTeX formulas and Mermaid diagrams are displayed as source text. They do not execute code.
TableHeaderNote: The first row is the header.
UnsavedText: If you don't save, your changes will be lost.
SaveError: Could not save “{0}”. Check that you have permission to write to its folder and that the file isn't read-only or open in another app. ({1})
InvalidEncoding: Invalid encoding: this file isn't valid UTF-8 text, so Amoxtli doesn't show or edit it. The file was not modified.
ChangedOnDisk: The file changed on disk. Your unsaved changes were kept; save them to replace the file.
WelcomeEditing: Switch between **Source**, **Format** and **Split** at the top of the window. Write Markdown in Source, apply styles from the toolbar or the **Format** menu, and save with **Ctrl+S**.
